instruction: Can you remove all favorite applications except google-chrome?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing all favorite apps except google-chrome. Initial state has [thunderbird, vim, chrome], final state should have [chrome] only. Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts GNOME favorite-apps setting using gsettings command
Metric correctly compares both length and set equality of apps lists
Expected value ['google-chrome.desktop'] correctly represents the final desired state
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement in the instruction
Data flow is correct: getter extracts favorite-apps list, metric compares against expected, returns binary result
No postconfig needed: favorite-apps is a persistent system setting accessible anytime via gsettings
